LanguageService

class LanguageService[source]

Bases: object

Detect, save and apply the application language.

Attributes:
settingsQSettings

Configuration file at PathConfig.config().

current_languagestr

Language chosen at creation by get_initial_language.

Notes

The application translations are .qm files in the Qt resources (PathConfig.translation). Qt’s own qt_help translation is also loaded when available, so the help widgets (search, index) are translated too.

Methods

apply_language

Apply a language for good.

get_initial_language

Return the language to use when the application starts.

get_saved_language

Return the saved language, or the default language.

get_system_language

Return the language of the operating system.

preview_language

Load a language for preview only.

save_language

Save the user's language choice.
get_saved_language()[source]

Return the saved language, or the default language.

Returns:
str

The code saved under AppConfig.SETTINGS_GERAL_LANGUAGE if it is supported, otherwise Language.DEFAULT_LANGUAGE.

save_language(code)[source]

Save the user’s language choice.

Parameters:
codestr

Language code, e.g. "es_ES". It is not validated.

Notes

The configuration file is synced to disk immediately.

get_system_language()[source]

Return the language of the operating system.

Returns:
str

QLocale.system().name(), e.g. "pt_BR".

get_initial_language()[source]

Return the language to use when the application starts.

Returns:
str

A supported language code.

Notes

Priority:

  1. The saved language, when it differs from the default (an explicit user choice).

  2. The system language, if supported: exact match first, then the first supported code with the same language prefix (e.g. en_GB gives en_US).

  3. Language.DEFAULT_LANGUAGE (pt_BR).

A saved pt_BR cannot be told apart from “nothing saved”, so it does not override the system language.

preview_language(code)[source]

Load a language for preview only.

Parameters:
codestr

Language code.

Returns:
bool

True if the translation was installed.

Notes

Nothing is saved and the date and time masks are not changed.

apply_language(code)[source]

Apply a language for good.

Parameters:
codestr

Language code.

Returns:
bool

True if the translation was installed and the choice saved; False if it could not be loaded (nothing is saved).

Notes

Besides installing the translators, this saves the language, sets the date and hour/minute masks (US formats for en_US, the default formats otherwise) and updates AppModel.current_language.
